input.question: What is the population of West Township?

documents.text: West Township, Marshall County, Indiana West Township is one of ten townships in Marshall County, Indiana, United States. As of the 2010 census, its population was 4,008 and it contained 1,729 housing units. West Township was organized in 1854. The Chief Menominee Memorial Site and Ramsay-Fox Round Barn and Farm are listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
